verdicts.RBP-F001: closed. The trace is per send and is passed as judge(&self, req, trace: &SendTrace) rather than carried on JudgeRequest (r-7 D8.2, sample l.763). A rustdoc on SendTrace explains the Arc<OnceLock> (sample l.721-722).
verdicts.RBP-F002: closed. Question is #[serde(try_from = RawQuestion)] with one Question::try_new that both crates use (r-5 D1/D2). QuestionKind {Choice, Score, Noul} uses skip_serializing_if = is_choice, so the bytes are unchanged.
verdicts.RBP-F003: closed. OrderedMap rejects duplicate keys, and the response uses RESPONSE_INVALID. JevState::Object is OrderedMap<String, Value>. JevQuestion has one validating constructor for the criteria counts.
